name: io.github.leo9/brek-direct-booking
title: Brek — Book Direct
description: Search Airbnb vacation rentals and find direct booking options for the same homes.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.usageNotes: Search vacation rentals by destination, dates, guests, property type and amenities, or look up a specific Airbnb room URL or exact ID. Search returns Airbnb source-platform trip totals and mapped owner booking links when available; lookup returns mapped operator URLs for the exact home. A missing match is a normal result. Direct prices, availability, fees, terms and savings must be confirmed on the booking website. The tools do not contact hosts, reserve stays or process payments.
